entries.zh-Hans: 敌方意图索引在失败后发生变化；将继续完成该敌方回合。
entries.en: The enemy intent index changed after failure; the enemy turn will finish.

entries.zh-Hans: 已跳过该异常敌方意图，继续结算。
entries.en: Skipped the invalid enemy intent and continued resolution.

entries.zh-Hans: 敌方意图完成时战斗状态已丢失。
entries.en: Battle state was lost when the enemy intent completed.

entries.zh-Hans: 阵师存活时，玩家回合开始自动触发当前地势收益一次。地势牌可额外触发；紫色边光提示换势、双效或减耗。
entries.en: While the Formation Master lives, the current terrain benefit triggers at the start of each player turn. Terrain cards can trigger it again; a purple edge indicates a terrain switch, double benefit, or reduced cost.

entries.zh-Hans: 结束本回合，进入敌方行动
entries.en: End this turn and let the enemies act

entries.zh-Hans: 选择一张尚未完成任务的主角牌
entries.en: Choose a Hero card whose task is unfinished

entries.zh-Hans: 洞察：选择一张加入手牌
entries.en: Insight: choose a card to add to your hand

entries.zh-Hans: 该卡无法进入手动目标选择。
entries.en: This card cannot enter manual target selection.

entries.zh-Hans: 该卡当前没有合法目标。
entries.en: This card has no legal target right now.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗胜利奖励未能生成。
entries.en: Victory rewards could not be generated.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗失败后未能返回城镇。
entries.en: Could not return to town after defeat.

entries.zh-Hans: 首张主动打出的任务牌决定阵赏。
entries.en: The first actively played task card determines the formation reward.

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔伤害或治疗使任一角色气血变化时，自身获得1点药效。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency whenever a damage or healing event changes any unit's HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次实际治疗或造成药效反转伤害时，自身获得2点药效。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency on the first effective heal or reversed Potency damage each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 累计清除友方3点流血、中毒或灼烧，自身获得1点药效；余数保留。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency per 3 stacks of Bleed, Poison, or Burn removed from allies; carry over the remainder.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方气血从不低于35%降至35%以下，自身获得3点药效。
entries.en: Gain 3 Potency the first time an ally falls from at least 35% HP to below 35% each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每3笔有效友方治疗抽1张牌，每回合最多2张。
entries.en: Draw 1 card per 3 effective allied healing events, up to 2 cards each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次清除友方流血，全队获得相当于药师20%防御的护甲，受开方品质增幅。
entries.en: The first removal of allied Bleed each round grants all allies Armor equal to 20% of the Apothecary's Defense, increased by Prescription quality.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方气血从不低于30%降至30%以下，该友方获得2层灵动。
entries.en: The first ally to fall from at least 30% HP to below 30% each round gains 2 Agility stacks.

entries.zh-Hans: 同次结算使至少3个不同单位实际气血变化：抽1张牌，全队恢复2内力；每回合1次。
entries.en: When the same resolution changes the HP of at least 3 different units, draw 1 card and restore 2 Inner Power to all allies; 1 time per round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔中毒伤害生效时，自身获得1点药效。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency each time Poison deals damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合，具有流血和中毒的敌人各获得1层标记，每名敌人1次。
entries.en: Each round, enemies with both Bleed and Poison gain 1 Mark, 1 time per enemy.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次使至少2名敌人获得中毒，自身获得2点药效并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency and draw 1 card the first time you apply Poison to at least 2 enemies each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每次毒爆包含至少2类持续伤害，自身获得2点药效。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency whenever a Poison Burst contains at least 2 damage-over-time types.

entries.zh-Hans: 每2笔流血伤害生效，自身获得1点药效；余数保留。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency per 2 Bleed damage events; carry over the remainder.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次直接攻击命中至少2名敌人，回复1气。
entries.en: Restore 1 Qi the first time a direct attack hits at least 2 enemies each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次给已中毒的敌人施加破绽，自身获得1点药效并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency and draw 1 card the first time you apply Vulnerability to a Poisoned enemy each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次毒爆同时包含流血、中毒、灼烧，自身获得1层气势并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 1 Momentum and draw 1 card the first time a Poison Burst contains Bleed, Poison, and Burn together each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合每名友方首次实际失血时，自身获得1点药效，最多计3名友方。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency the first time each ally actually loses HP each round, counting up to 3 allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次在治疗或反转中消耗至少6点药效，抽1张牌。
entries.en: Draw 1 card the first time a heal or reversal consumes at least 6 Potency each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 毒爆包含至少2类持续伤害时，自身获得2点药效，每回合最多2次。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency when a Poison Burst contains at least 2 damage-over-time types, up to 2 times each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次在同次结算中有效治疗至少2名友方，回复1气。
entries.en: Restore 1 Qi the first time the same resolution effectively heals at least 2 allies each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 各牌首次主动打出后记录牌序。
entries.en: Records the order of each card's first active play.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动打出其中任意一张即可开启。
entries.en: Actively play any of these cards to activate.

entries.zh-Hans: 通用先手，分支由下一张任务牌锁定。
entries.en: Universal opener; the next task card locks the branch.

entries.zh-Hans: 依记录顺序重放中，随后结算阵赏。
entries.en: Replaying in the recorded order, then resolving the formation reward.
All cards in this group have been recorded.

entries.en: Already triggered this round; resets next round.

entries.zh-Hans: 生命降至1%时消耗，进入下一阶段并回满生命。
entries.en: Consumed at 1% HP to enter the next phase and fully restore HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 药方未开启 · 首次主动打出激活本场效果
entries.en: Prescription inactive · First active play enables its effect for this battle

entries.zh-Hans: 冲锋就绪 · 本回合第一张主动牌
entries.en: Opener ready · First active card this round

entries.zh-Hans: 收招候选 · 留作最后一张主动牌时生效
entries.en: Finisher candidate · Takes effect if kept as the last active card

entries.zh-Hans: 承接刀式 · 下一张主动牌可触发已登记的冲锋联动
entries.en: Blade follow-up · The next active card can trigger the registered Opener synergy

entries.zh-Hans: 护甲转伤 · 伤害来源已有可用护甲
entries.en: Armor to damage · The damage source has usable Armor
Available from the ally with the highest Attack

entries.zh-Hans: 药效联动 · 本牌可使用药效治疗或反转
entries.en: Potency synergy · This card can use Potency to heal or reverse

entries.zh-Hans: 毒爆联动 · 可选目标已有持续伤害
entries.en: Poison Burst synergy · A selectable target has damage over time

entries.zh-Hans: 地势收益 · 本牌会触发或切换地势
entries.en: Terrain benefit · This card triggers or switches terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 直接攻击的暴击概率，最高20%。本页不计局内临时效果。
entries.en: Critical chance for direct attacks, capped at 20%. This page excludes temporary run effects.

entries.zh-Hans: 暴击时使用的伤害倍率。基础150%，天赋最多增加50个百分点。
entries.en: Damage multiplier on a critical hit. Base 150%; talents add up to 50 percentage points.

entries.zh-Hans: 宝石作用于角色、装备与固定宝石合计的数值，再乘永久天赋百分比；两类不是直接相加。宝石部分边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Gems apply to the combined character, equipment, and flat gem values, then multiply by permanent talent percentages; the two categories are not added together. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 物理直击先受防御减伤，再由护甲吸收。宝石先按75%上限递减，再乘终伤天赋；暴击和局内临时效果另算。
entries.en: Physical direct hits are reduced by Defense before Armor absorbs them. Gems diminish toward a 75% cap, then multiply by final damage talents; critical hits and temporary run effects are calculated separately.

entries.zh-Hans: 对应法术直击跳过防御，受同系抗性减伤，护甲仍可吸收。元素宝石按75%上限递减后乘终伤天赋，不叠加物理宝石；暴击另算。
entries.en: Matching spell direct hits bypass Defense, are reduced by elemental resistance, and can still be absorbed by Armor. Elemental gems diminish toward a 75% cap before multiplying by final damage talents; they do not stack with physical gems. Critical hits are separate.

entries.zh-Hans: 仅放大已触发的物理反击，不增加触发次数。物理与反击宝石合并递减，上限75%，再乘终伤天赋。
entries.en: Amplifies triggered physical counterattacks without adding triggers. Physical and counterattack gems share diminishing returns capped at 75%, then multiply by final damage talents.

entries.zh-Hans: 提高流血、中毒及对应引爆的伤害，不增加层数，不含蚀伤。自然伤害看施加者，主动引爆看触发者；宝石边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Increases Bleed, Poison, and their burst damage without adding stacks; excludes Corrosion. Natural ticks use the applier; active bursts use the triggerer. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 持续伤害与火焰宝石合并递减，上限75%。灼烧与引燃受火焰抗性减伤，仍直接扣气血。
entries.en: Damage-over-time and fire gems share diminishing returns capped at 75%. Burn and Ignite are reduced by fire resistance but still remove HP directly.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合开始保留上回合护甲的比例。不包含本局临时获得的全部保留效果。
entries.en: The share of last round's Armor retained at each round start. Excludes temporary effects that retain all Armor during this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 提高主动治疗牌及其重放产生的治疗量；不含吸血、复活和固定套装额外恢复。宝石边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Increases healing from active healing cards and their replays; excludes lifesteal, revival, and extra recovery from fixed set bonuses. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 只减免同系法术伤害。宝石根据基础抗性向75%上限递减，不直接相加；护甲仍能吸收法术直击，战斗中的临时减抗另算。
entries.en: Reduces only matching elemental spell damage. Gems diminish from base resistance toward a 75% cap rather than adding directly. Armor can still absorb spell direct hits; temporary battle resistance reductions are separate.

entries.zh-Hans: 暂不编入未完成：该操作仅可在城镇的可编辑状态执行。
entries.en: Could not bench the companion: this action requires an editable town state.

entries.zh-Hans: 已暂不编入永久伙伴；本次路线可仅由主角与任务 NPC 出战。
entries.en: Permanent companion benched; the Hero and task NPC can enter this route together.

entries.zh-Hans: 名册已满：新伙伴已固定保存，请选择替换对象或放弃候选。
entries.en: Roster full: the new companion is held for your decision. Choose a replacement or decline.

entries.zh-Hans: 招贤未能完成，请稍后重试。
entries.en: Recruitment could not be completed. Please try again.

entries.zh-Hans: 遣散未完成：至少保留一名伙伴。
entries.en: Could not dismiss: keep at least one companion.

entries.zh-Hans: 已遣散该伙伴，装备已返还到背包。
entries.en: Companion dismissed; equipment returned to the backpack.

entries.zh-Hans: 替换未完成：请先卸下装备并清空已投入经验，再替换该伙伴。
entries.en: Could not replace: remove equipment and clear invested experience first.

entries.zh-Hans: 已完成替换，并自动选中新伙伴。
entries.en: Replacement complete; the new companion is selected.

entries.zh-Hans: 放弃候选未完成，请稍后重试。
entries.en: Could not decline the candidate. Please try again.

entries.zh-Hans: 已放弃本次候选；下次招贤将继续后续卡池顺序。
entries.en: Candidate declined; the next recruitment continues from the next pool entry.

entries.zh-Hans: 本次路线已锁定，无法遣散。
entries.en: This route is locked; dismissal is unavailable.

entries.zh-Hans: 至少保留一名伙伴，无法遣散。
entries.en: Keep at least one companion; dismissal is unavailable.

entries.zh-Hans: 遣散当前伙伴并让候选入队；装备与经验材料将返还。
entries.en: Dismiss this companion and accept the candidate; equipment and experience materials are returned.

entries.zh-Hans: 遣散当前伙伴；装备将返还到背包。
entries.en: Dismiss this companion; equipment returns to the backpack.

entries.en: This route is locked; the deck is read only.
